18: Brother of the head: Meaning, similar to him.
His contemporary (of the same character): Born under the same constellation (sign). They were both of the same mind.
He sought to destroy the foundation that Zerubavel had established for the Temple in the days of Cyrus, before Ahasuerus - like it is stated in the book of Ezra (4).
An accusation: One who was appointed to accuse them, so that they not build it.
